thread:
nina: Quick follow-up on streaming/chat partial-response pattern. Goal: list owners, acceptance, and short mitigations in one thread.

omar: Root cause summary: LB idle close + aggressive server buffer timeout + client reconnect semantics.

leo: Proposed tracks: infra keepalive canary, SDK safe-reconnect + idempotency header, server trailing-final signal and bumped buffer timeout.

paul: I can do infra: canary keepalive 60->240s in us-east-1, monitor fd usage and RST counts. ETA 2026-05-02.

omar: I'll do runtime: add feature-flagged streaming.final_token envelope, increase internal buffer timeout to 150s, add dedupe by X-Stream-Id. ETA 2026-04-29.

leo: SDKs: implement X-Stream-Id, exponential reconnect with jitter, doc samples. ETA 2026-04-27.

ops-bot: incident INC-2026-114 opened by nina (P2).

nina: Observability + tests?

paul: I'll add dashboard for streaming.partial_rate and an alert if >0.5% over 5m, and a runbook item. ETA 2026-04-25.

leo: CI: add chaos socket-drop test asserting final_token or trailing-error envelope. ETA 2026-04-26.

nina: Acceptance criteria: infra shows no truncated streams in 24h canary and fd <75%; SDKs show no duplicate completions in 48h synthetic traffic; runtime emits final_token and passes long-run tests; CI reproduces old failure with old config and passes with new.

omar: PRs: runtime draft https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/1012, SDK PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/435, infra canary https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/321, e2e test PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/e2e-tests/pull/167.

ops-bot: Reminder set for 2026-04-22 09:00 UTC: "streaming postmortem follow-up" (weekly x2).

nina: Please paste status updates here when PRs land. We'll consider INC-2026-114 resolved after acceptance criteria + 7d stability.

paul: Canary started in us-east-1 (canary_id cny-129). Posting metrics to #eng-sre in 30m.

leo: I'll add unit tests for final_token parser to ensure it's not treated as model content.

nina: Thanks all, keeping thread as canonical tracker.
